summary: Pacific Airport Group filed a Form 6-K announcing Q1 2026 earnings and operational updates, along with a pending business combination to integrate Cross Border Xpress (CBX) and internalize technical assistance services. No definitive agreement has been executed; the combination was approved at a shareholders' meeting on December 11, 2025, but no terms, price, premium, or timeline are provided. The filing also notes the issuance of bond certificates for Ps.10,718 million (GAP 26 and GAP 26-2) to partly fund a 25% CBX stake acquisition. This is a routine earnings report with a pending deal mention, not a special-situation trigger itself.
